name: Distro 10 - (5g) Baller Bucket - Oreoz
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, bulk size. The Distro 10 Oreoz Baller Bucket packs a full 5 grams of live resin — full-spectrum concentrate extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with. Bold, flavorful, and built for people who go through it.

Oreoz is a potent, dessert-forward hybrid born from crossing Cookies & Cream with Secret Weapon. Expect exactly what the name suggests: rich chocolate and sweet cookie notes up front, layered with creamy vanilla and a subtly gassy, earthy finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — a heavy, deeply relaxing calm that makes it a strong pick for evenings and unwinding.

Why you'll love it:

5G live resin — bulk value in one bucket, fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Oreoz flavor — rich chocolate and sweet cookie with creamy vanilla and gas
Bucket packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Distro 10 Oreoz is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
